denial.payer_remark: Service not deemed medically necessary on the information submitted.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-20
Patient: 67-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: low back pain
History: low back pain for 5 weeks. Ibuprofen and home exercises for 5 weeks with partial relief.
Examination: possible mild weakness of ankle dorsiflexion, limited by pain; reflexes symmetric; sensation intact.
Assessment: low back pain, possible early nerve root irritation.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-02-20.

expected.rationale: Five weeks of treatment is short of the six the policy asks for, so the case depends on a neurological deficit. The note says 'possible' weakness 'limited by pain'. Calling that a deficit would overstate the record; whether it is one is a clinical judgement.
